audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer and content level charts both give Yasuo levels 2 and 3 and Gragas levels 4-5 as 'Skill', contradicting the packet chart (Skill/Gragas/Skill/Gragas/Gragas/Yasuo/Yasuo) and contradicting the whys text on the same page, which says Gragas out-trades at 2 with W-auto plus detonated Q, that 3 is awkward/even, and that 4-5 W max plus Happy Hour wins.
audit.why: 51.65% over 728 games with Gragas owning the pre-crit window; the chart must match the prose it sits next to.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Level 2 Gragas, Level 3 Skill, Levels 4-5 Gragas, Level 6 Gragas, First item Yasuo, 2+ items Yasuo — proposed as one atomic group across both layers.

audit.why: Spikes are already right: Gragas at 2 (Q+W), 6 (E-W-Q-R), first item; Yasuo at his first crit item and 2+ items where he outscales.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Last Breath as the matchup-defining cooldown to track. It is not: Last Breath requires an Airborne target, so it only comes off Yasuo's own double-stacked Steel Tempest. The cooldown that actually decides the lane is Wind Wall — 25/23/21/19/17s — and the page never gives that number.
audit.why: Gragas' entire trade pattern is Q detonation plus cask; Wind Wall is what denies it, and 25s at rank 1 is a huge exploitable window. Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, not the flat '13 seconds' the page states.
audit.corrected: Bait Wind Wall, then commit E-W-Q inside its 25s downtime; Last Breath (70/50/30s) can only follow his own Steel Tempest knockup.
